<function name="ExpandRecurse" parent="DTree_Node" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
Expands or collapses this node, as well as ALL child nodes of this node.

Works opposite of <page>DTree_Node:ExpandTo</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="expand" type="boolean">Whether to expand (true) or collapse (false)</arg>
	</args>
</function>
